# JsonRock

> Browser-based JSON visualizer, formatter, and validator for developers. Free, runs entirely in the browser, no signup required.

## Tools
- [JSON Formatter](https://jsonrock.com/json-formatter): Format, beautify, and minify raw JSON instantly
- [JSON Graph Viewer](https://jsonrock.com/json-graph-viewer): Visualize nested JSON data as an interactive graph
- [JSON Tree Explorer](https://jsonrock.com/json-tree-explorer): Browse deeply nested JSON as a collapsible tree
- [Diff Checker](https://jsonrock.com/diff): Compare two JSON documents side by side
- [Markdown Editor](https://jsonrock.com/editor/markdown): Write and preview Markdown with live rendering
- [HTML Editor](https://jsonrock.com/editor/html): Preview HTML code in real time
- [Text Editor](https://jsonrock.com/editor/text): Minimal browser-based text editor with shareable links
